run_upload_gtest: run upload_gtest.py to upload a Google Test patch for review with automatic CC
run_upload_gtest_with_cc: run upload_gtest.py with custom --cc flags to add extra reviewers to the patch upload
review_main: review the main function that wraps upload.py and auto-appends the Google Test mailing list CC
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support additional default CC recipients beyond the GTest group
summarize_main: summarize the main function which parses CLI args, modifies --cc flags, and invokes upload.py via os.execv
